summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.76/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.76 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 16, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 10¢ lower than a week ago, 71¢ lower than a month ago, and 91¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.58) and the highest in Rhinelander ($3.98).
